title: Record highlights drop the year on current-year dates ("End Date Sep 15" beside "Start Date Sep 15, 2025"), so an expired contract reads as ending next month — always show the year (hotcrm#2194 T1-U07)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 记录头部的日期在当年时省略年份，合同 CTR-0003「结束日期 Sep 15」看起来像下个月到期，其实今年 9 月已过期。
- **要做：** 头部高亮字段的日期始终显示年份。
- **完成标准：** 同一条记录的两个日期格式一致、都带年份。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **T1-U07**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** contract record CTR-0003, admin (HotCRM).
- **Now:** the header reads "Start Date Sep 15, 2025 | End Date Sep 15". The current year is dropped, so a contract that ended this September looks like it ends next month. The same compact format appears on opportunity close dates ("Close Date Nov 19").
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [track 1 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/REPORT.md), U-07; [`97-ux-U-07-date-without-year.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/f7297f63d58f8c3e1b9b466ee241a05d3af9a5c8/qa/2026-10-20-full-pass/shots/97-ux-U-07-date-without-year.png). Re-measured unchanged on `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 by the round 2 pass ([round 2 track 1 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/dda91814dfe304ec48e616f5886491ecd7e8ade3/qa/2026-10-20-v18-full/REPORT.md), the section's opening paragraph).

## Landing

- The console's date formatter for record highlight fields (the compact form that omits the current year). The dev locates it on `main` and measures whether the grid uses the same formatter.

## Done when

- Highlight dates always carry the year, so one record's two dates read alike.
- A formatter test with a current-year and a past-year date.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `date`, `year`, `highlight`. 5 hits, all closed and other date surfaces: #13234 (a grouped grid's raw date heading), #13149 (calendar header), and #13154, #13045, #13008. Not on point. **New.**
